intro: Bristleback Quilboar Tusks are harvested from the slain Bristleback quilboar across the northern and central Barrens. Collected as proof of slaughter, they serve as gruesome tokens of vengeance for the grieving orc warrior Mankrik.

p: Bristleback quilboar inhabit thickets and bramble dens throughout the Barrens, fiercely defending their territory against Horde expansion. Their tusks are prominent, jagged ivory used as natural weapons in close quarters. For Mankrik, a veteran warrior stationed at the Crossroads whose wife was lost during a vicious quilboar ambush, these tusks represent more than simple hunter trophies. Collecting dozens of them is a measure of pure retribution, a bloody tally meant to ensure the Bristlebacks suffer as deeply as he has.
